editorial_collections_dates_check.name: editorial_collections_dates_check
editorial_collections_dates_check.value: "editorial_collections"."ends_at" is null or "editorial_collections"."starts_at" is null or "editorial_collections"."ends_at" > "editorial_collections"."starts_at"

media_assets_availability_check.name: media_assets_availability_check
media_assets_availability_check.value: "media_assets"."expires_at" is null or "media_assets"."available_at" is null or "media_assets"."expires_at" > "media_assets"."available_at"

notification_preferences_global_unique.name: notification_preferences_global_unique
notification_preferences_global_unique.where: "notification_preferences"."athlete_id" is null and "notification_preferences"."team_id" is null and "notification_preferences"."sport_id" is null and "notification_preferences"."competition_id" is null

notification_preferences_quiet_hours_che.name: notification_preferences_quiet_hours_check
notification_preferences_quiet_hours_che.value: ("notification_preferences"."quiet_hours_start" is null and "notification_preferences"."quiet_hours_end" is null) or ("notification_preferences"."quiet_hours_start" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' and "notification_preferences"."quiet_hours_end" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')

streams_locator_check.name: streams_locator_check
streams_locator_check.value: ("streams"."protocol" = 'external' and "streams"."external_watch_url" is not null) or ("streams"."protocol" <> 'external' and "streams"."playback_locator" is not null)
